title: Register every split portable suite explicitly in CTest
problem: The previous test list used combined source files and existence guards, which can turn a missing regression into an apparently successful configure.
example:
cmake -S . -B build/cmake -DFFMT_BUILD_TESTS=ON
cmake --build build/cmake -j2
ctest --test-dir build/cmake --output-on-failure
design: Explicit source registrations preserve the decomposed suites, while Python discovers all capability unit tests. Configure verifies a clean pinned oracle; only tests discover Python and Git.
tradeoffs: Full tests require the complete feature checkout and independent oracle. Optional extension skips remain visible, and C++23 stays opt-in. This is host validation, not accelerator runtime qualification.

validation.results: Pending independent review and assembled portable validation.
validation.limitations: Run on the assembled complete-feature commit. Inspect skip counts; an extension skip is not a pass. Missing declared C++ sources must fail configuration. No hosted/device result is implied.

source_changes: Build integration and documentation only; no formatter implementation changes.
